scripts.test:env: node --version && codex --version && echo '✓ CLI installed (not auth)'
scripts.test:codex-auth: codex auth status 2>/dev/null || codex whoami 2>/dev/null || echo '⚠ auth status unavailable — run test:bridge to verify login'
scripts.test:sdk: node --input-type=module --eval "import('@openai/codex-sdk').then(m => { const keys = Object.keys(m); console.log('✓ SDK exports:', keys); if (!keys.includes('Codex')) process.exit(1); })"
scripts.test:bridge:stdin: printf '%s' 'ping，用一句话回复' | node scripts/debate-bridge.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:env && npm run test:sdk && npm run test:bridge
